title: Overhead Finish Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 134bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
They lobbed it short
Ball is high above your head
Turn sideways early
Reach up tall and ready

[Whisper verse]
Feet shuffle back two steps
Non paddle hand points up
Paddle behind the head
Grip pressure six out of ten

Contact in front of the head
Reach with the legs and core
Level swing path down
Flat face square aimed down

[Tribal drop chant]
Overhead finish overhead finish
Reach and reach reach and reach
Vamos firme pa lante
Overhead finish overhead finish

[Whisper verse]
Target the open court
Deep corner or sideline
Medium pace controlled
Clear the net by three feet

Follow through across the body
Return to ready balanced
Reset feet to the line
Breath out and reset eyes

[Tribal drop chant]
Overhead finish overhead finish
Reach and reach reach and reach
Vamos firme pa lante
Overhead finish overhead finish

[Whisper outro]
Reach tall
Control down
Reach tall
Control down
